Mejiro McQueen undergoes fundamental 
training in preparation for the Tenno Sho.

Believing her training regimen wasn't 
practical for winning races, the people 
around turned critical eyes toward the 
Trainer.

As a result... an awkward tension began to 
drift between Mejiro McQueen and her 
Trainer.

Mejiro McQueen is troubled. However, 
Mejiro Ryan's words make her realize that 
she needs to place her trust in her 
Trainer.

Mejiro McQueen and her Trainer resolved to 
place their deep trust in one another, 
renewing their vows and stepping forward 
in unison toward the Tenno Sho.
